Interface Token

All Known Implementing Classes:
Token.DeclToken, Token.IndexToken, Token.RegToken
public sealed interface Token permits Token.IndexToken, Token.DeclToken, Token.RegToken
The within-owner identifier of an Address — paired with an OwnerRef and a KindTag to name exactly one addressable thing.

One token shape per identity source

  • Token.IndexToken — a slot's vanilla menu-space index. Used by BOTH vanilla and created slots (they share one menu space, which is why they "look identical through the window"). Reopen-stable because Mojang's menu index is deterministic.
  • Token.DeclToken — a deterministic declaration id, used as the durable identity of a created slot or a panel element. For a created slot it derives from its registration-order coordinate (group + localIndex); for a panel element it is the consumer-supplied declId or, absent that, its registration position in the panel's element list (see PanelElement.getElementDeclId()). String form keeps it deterministic + serializable; interning to a long is a later perf-only option.
  • Token.RegToken — a panel's registration key, identifying the panel itself (for its own properties).

FROZEN-OPEN

New token shapes are additive; resolution mechanics switch on the token subtype ONLY to fetch the live backing (a lookup, never a behavior/cascade decision). The invariant: never cross KindTag (applicability) with the token subtype (resolution).
